summary.text: Mark Owens is a Republican state representative from Oregon House District 60 who has served since January 2020 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Mark Owens assumed office in the Oregon House of Representatives on January 31, 2020, succeeding Lynn Findley.

In the 2023-2024 session, Owens was assigned to the Agriculture and Land Use Committee (as vice chair), the Business and Labor Committee, the House Energy and Environment Committee and the Joint Conduct Committee.
He advanced from the Republican primary on May 19, 2026.
